text.p: Astrocom Corp said Tuesday that T.J. Carter has resigned as president and Ronald Thomas, recently appointed chief executive officer, will assume those additional duties.

Carter will pursue other opportunities, including the possible formation of a separate company to develop the port extender technology, in which Astrocom may retain an interest, Astrocom said in a news release.

In a related action, four engineering positions were eliminated. The engineers who had filled these positions may also be involved in any venture formed to continue the port extender development project, the company said.
Officials of Astrocom, which provides voice and data access products, were not immediately available to provide more information.
